title: AquaPredict M1 Exploratory Waterlogging Susceptibility Analysis
disclaimer: EXPLORATORY WATERLOGGING SUSCEPTIBILITY — NOT A VALIDATED FLOOD FORECAST

terrain_depressions.name: Local Topographic Depressions (Ponding Sinks)
terrain_depressions.method: Morphological reconstruction sink filling on 1m DEM
terrain_depressions.rationale: Closed topographical depressions collect overland runoff before spilling over.

relative_elevation.name: Topographic Position Index (TPI)
relative_elevation.method: Elevation relative to 30m moving neighborhood mean
relative_elevation.rationale: Identifies local swales, hollows, and valleys regardless of absolute sea level elevation.

slope_flatness.name: Surface Slope Flatness
slope_flatness.rationale: Slopes < 1.5° impede overland runoff evacuation velocity and promote surface ponding.

drainage_proximity.name: Distance to Nearest Storm Inlet
drainage_proximity.method: CRS-aware 2D Euclidean distance to nearest City of Houston storm inlet
drainage_proximity.rationale: Screening indicator for overland flow path travel distance to mapped municipal intake points.

limitations_and_guardrails: Screening Tool Only: This analysis highlights terrain-based ponding tendencies; it is NOT a certified 1D/2D hydrodynamic model or real-time flood warning system.
DEM Artifacts: Highway overpasses, bridges, or culverts not burned into the raw LiDAR may create false artificial dams in depression calculations.
Subsurface Drainage Not Modeled: Proximity to an inlet does not evaluate whether that inlet or pipe has hydraulic capacity, is clogged, or suffers from bayou backwater.
Rainfall Excluded: No rainfall intensity or storm events (e.g. 10-yr, 100-yr) are modeled in this milestone.
Pilot Domain Restriction: Analysis is strictly confined to the 0.97 km² Downtown Houston study sector and cannot be extrapolated citywide.
